plugins.name: smoothcaret
plugins.settings_integration: Defines config.plugins.smoothcaret.config_spec for the settings GUI. No require of plugins.settings; the spec is inert when the settings plugin is absent (it is absent in this repo).
monkeypatches: DocView:update (wraps and calls the previous implementation, then animates caret positions)
DocView:draw_caret (wraps and calls the previous implementation using the animated position)
host_apis_used: Doc.data:get_selections (iterated as idx, line1, col1, line2, col2)
Doc.selections (flat array; used only for count-change detection)

checks: View:move_towards(t, k, dest, rate, name) exists at data/core/view.lua:69 and supports the table-first overload used by smoothcaret.

Doc:get_selections(sort_intra, idx_reverse) exists at data/core/doc/init.lua:289; iterator yields idx, line1, col1, line2, col2. smoothcaret consumes line1,col1, which matches the local DocView:draw_overlay caret placement (also line1,col1).
DocView:get_visible_line_range exists at data/core/docview.lua:164; get_line_screen_position at :145; draw_caret at :474; update at :411.
risks: #self.doc.selections is a flat array of 4 numbers per selection in this repo, so 'last_n_selections' is 4*n, not n. It still detects any selection-count change (4*n changes), so the reset-on-new-caret branch still fires; the name/semantics are misleading but behavior is preserved.

Doc:get_selection_idx and get_selections expose the selection anchor (line1,col1) first. That matches local draw_overlay, so caret placement is consistent, but for reversed selections the animated caret follows the anchor rather than the cursor end.

IME: data/core/docview.lua:556 calls self:draw_caret from draw_ime_decoration with a shifted x. smoothcaret ignores the supplied x and uses its own stored absolute position, so the composition caret may not follow the IME decoration precisely.

Co-load ordering: custom_caret replaces DocView:draw_caret without calling through; if it loads after smoothcaret it discards smoothcaret's wrapper and smooth animation stops. See the global risk entry.

plugins.name: custom_caret
optional_requires: plugins.settings (via pcall(require, "plugins.settings"); settings-UI integration only; absent in this repo, so the pcall returns false and the block is skipped)

config_options.caret_color: table.pack(table.unpack(style.caret)) captured at load from the active color scheme

plugins.settings_integration: If plugins.settings is loadable, the core.add_thread callback sets config.plugins.custom_caret.config_spec and calls settings.ui:enable_plugin("custom_caret"). checks: Doc:get_selection_idx(idx, sort) exists at data/core/doc/init.lua:185; returns line1, col1, line2, col2.
Doc:get_char(line, col) exists at data/core/doc/init.lua:370 and sanitizes the position before returning one character.
Doc.lines exists and is a flat array of lines including trailing newline (data/core/doc/init.lua:38).
style.caret is set by data/colors/default.lua, which data/core/init.lua requires at line 5 before user plugins load.
DocView:get_line_height (:134), get_line_screen_position (:145), get_line_text_y_offset (:157), get_font, draw_caret (:474) and update (:411) exist.
renderer.draw_rect / renderer.draw_text are the same native renderer entry points already used by data/core/docview.lua.
risks: caret_idx is incremented once per DocView:draw_caret call, but local draw_overlay calls draw_caret only for selections whose line1 is visible (data/core/docview.lua:565-577). With off-screen earlier selections, caret_idx no longer equals the selection index, so the block/underline width and surrounding characters can be computed from the wrong selection. This is an upstream assumption, not a missing API.

doc:get_selection_idx returns the selection anchor (line1,col1) first, not a sorted/cursor-end position. custom_caret draws the block/underline and samples get_char at that anchor. Local draw_overlay also places the caret at line1,col1, so placement is consistent, but a reversed selection shows the block at the anchor.

style.caret is read at file-load time for the caret_color default. Normal startup loads colors.default before user plugins; loading custom_caret before any color scheme sets style.caret would error at table.unpack(style.caret).

Co-load ordering: custom_caret replaces DocView:draw_caret without calling through. If it loads after smoothcaret, smoothcaret's wrapper is discarded. If it loads before, smoothcaret wraps it, but custom_caret ignores the supplied animated x when recomputing char metrics (it uses get_selection_idx), so block/underline metrics may not track the animated caret.
IME: draw_ime_decoration calls self:draw_caret without resetting caret_idx semantics, so block/underline geometry during IME composition can be based on a shifted index.

static_safety_review.scope: Both canonical files read in full; static inspection only; no plugin executed, imported, built, or installed.
static_safety_review.no_network: No socket/http/curl/wget/ffi usage in either file.
static_safety_review.no_native_calls: No system.* native API usage in either file.
static_safety_review.no_host_file_io: Neither file reads or writes host files; no USERDIR/PATHSEP/system.absolute_path use.
static_safety_review.requires_allowlist: smoothcaret requires only core.*; custom_caret requires core.* plus an optional pcall(require, "plugins.settings") for settings UI only. plugins.settings is absent in this repo and the pcall fails safely.
static_safety_review.config_gating: smoothcaret is reversible at runtime via config.plugins.smoothcaret.enabled=false. custom_caret is always active once loaded and is parameterized by shape/custom_color/caret_color/surrounding_chars.
static_safety_review.verdict: No obfuscation, eval, network, native, or host-file side effects observed. Both files monkeypatch DocView methods at load, which is a behavioral, not a security, side effect.

Doc.get_selections.result: compatible (consumes line1, col1, matching local caret placement)

Doc.get_selection_idx.result: exists; caret_idx-to-selection-index alignment is the risk noted above

incompatibility_risks: custom_caret's caret_idx counts draw_caret invocations, not selection indices. Local draw_overlay skips off-screen selections (data/core/docview.lua:565-577), so multi-cursor documents with earlier off-screen selections can draw block/underline metrics and surrounding characters for the wrong selection.
custom_caret fully replaces DocView:draw_caret and does not call through. Loading it after smoothcaret removes smoothcaret's animation wrapper; loading order determines whether the two can coexist.

Both plugins monkeypatch global DocView methods at load time. They are not sandboxed per-view and affect every DocView, which is expected for Lite XL plugins but should be gated during any execution experiment.

Doc:get_selection_idx and Doc:get_selections return the selection anchor (line1,col1) first. Caret drawing therefore follows the anchor for reversed selections; this matches local draw_overlay but differs from a cursor-end convention.

smoothcaret treats #doc.selections (a flat 4-numbers-per-selection array locally) as a caret count. Change detection still works because the value changes with selection count, but it is not literally the number of carets.
style.caret must exist before custom_caret loads; normal startup (colors.default required before user plugins) satisfies this, but a nonstandard loader order would error.

IME composition calls this:draw_caret directly (data/core/docview.lua:556) with a shifted x; smoothcaret ignores that x, and custom_caret's caret_idx is not IME-aware. Both can misplace caret geometry during IME composition.
The optional settings integration in custom_caret cannot be exercised here because data/plugins/settings.lua is absent; the pcall path is safe but settings UI behavior is unverified.
